title: Interpretable and scalable spatial gene set activity analysis with GESSO uncovers functional tissue architecture.
snippet: Spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT) measures gene expression within tissues. Existing methods that summarize the activity of functionally related genes often ignore relationships between neighboring locations and offer limited statistical testing, gene-level interpretation, or scalability. title: Mapping cell-type-specific spatial gene programs uncovers tissue architecture and microenvironment organization.
snippet: The complex organization of tissues is shaped by the spatial arrangement of diverse cell types executing specialized gene programs. Cell-type-specific spatial gene programs (SGPs) are transcriptional modules that capture spatial expression co-variation within cell types.
